To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Jordan Price <jordan.price@acmehealth.com>
Date: Thu, 8 Apr 2026 10:22:00 -0700
Subject: Staged activation: resource commitments, docs owners, and exception windows

Team —

After the product review yesterday, we need to lock down how we’ll stage the go‑live for the Acme Health integration. The risks we agreed on are: variable traffic patterns, a handful of long‑running requests from SSO handshakes, and a docs gap for troubleshooting steps.

Ask for this email: please reply with owners and a short yes/no on the three decisions below by end of day Friday so we can finalize the ops runbook. I’ve attached a one‑page checklist and a brief comms digest.

Decisions to confirm:
- Activation cadence: weekday daytime ramp (Mon 9–5) vs weekend cold launch (Sat midnight).
- Exception policy: who can approve a temporary rollback or emergency throttle (names + escalation lane).
- Docs ownership: who will own the troubleshooting playbook, short KB, and rollout FAQ.

Quick notes:
- Engineering asks for a weekend window to minimize user impact but will need 2 oncall engineers for 24 hours.
- Support asks for a concise 1‑page FAQ targeted at clinical onboarding teams.

Attachments: staged-activation-checklist.xlsx, comm_plan-digest.md

Thanks,
Priyom
Product Manager, Integrations
Redwood Inference

+1 on weekend cold launch for reduced customer impact. If we do weekends we need:
- two dedicated infra engineers (I can rotate Marcus + one other; Marcus is out next week but back Mon)
- a rollback playbook validated by Security (Jordan B.),
- a pre‑cutover smoke checklist run 60/30/10 minutes before activation.

I’ll draft the rollback approval matrix (who signs off, what signals) and upload to the playbook draft in Drive.

Can @Ben confirm whether Sales needs a customer‑facing status template for Acme’s PMs?

Thanks everyone — this thread gives us what we need to finalize the plan. Summary of decisions (final):

1) Activation cadence: weekend cold launch (Sat 04/17 00:00 PT) — chosen to minimize clinical disruption.
2) Exception policy: Jordan Blake approves security exceptions 00:00–08:00 PT; Laura Bennett + Jordan Blake approve outside that window. Kimberly will publish the rollback approval matrix in Drive.
3) Docs ownership: Support will own the 1‑page FAQ (owner: Marissa Cole); Docs/KB triage + longer troubleshooting doc: Laura Bennett. Sales will own external comms template (owner: Ben Carter).

Open items and blockers:
- Marissa: need the FAQ by EOD Monday (2026‑04‑12) so Ben can share with Acme PMs.
- Kimberly: please post the rollback matrix and smoke checklist in Drive and tag the oncall rotation by 04/12.
- Engineering: confirm the two infra engineers for the Saturday window by 04/13.

Jordan Price (Acme) — thanks for the quick responses. Please confirm your SRE team is available for the 04/17 window and that we have your OK on weekend activation.

Laura Bennett
Director, Product Operations
